data.description:
# The `(inbound, probe)` dispatch chain is a documented subsystem with no live producer

## Status

DISCOVERED while fixing d103-c3f8-2fbc-4c97 / 727f-b351-59ba-4b3b. Not a regression those
fixes introduced - it predates them and neither changes it. Filed so it is not lost.

## What is unreachable

`differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes` is the only producer of
`(inbound, probe)` mutations. It iterates `local_state` looking for entries carrying a
bound `jira_key` field. Its sole production caller, `run_differs`, passes
`prev_snapshot` - a FETCHED Jira snapshot, whose entries never carry `jira_key`
(`fetcher.py`, and the contract shape in `_snapshot_schema.py`). The loop therefore never
emits, and everything downstream of it is dead in production:

* `_run_differs_inbound_probe_dispatch` in `run_differs.py`
* `inbound_probe.py` (`ProbeResult`, `ProbeBranch`, the router)
* `backend.probe_remote` / the `SupportsAbsenceProbe` capability

Confirmed empirically: fed a realistic fetched-snapshot pair, `compute_mutations` emits only
`jira_new`, `unbound_local` and `field_drift`. The only fixture in the repo that supplies a
`jira_key`-bearing `local_state` is
`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_differ_emits_probe.py`.

## Why it matters

This is the mechanism ADR 0028 para 2 relies on to tell "deleted" from "aged out of the fetch
window" - deletion is proven only by a bounded direct GET returning 404. With no live producer,
that discrimination is never exercised in production. Ticket b9b8 already reworked the live DC
cell `test_a_deleted_dc_issue_is_planned_as_an_inbound_probe` for exactly this reason: it
"asserted an observable no production path emits".

## What is NOT the fix

Do NOT re-enable the arm by making `run_differs` pass a `jira_key`-bearing local_state without
also removing `reconcile_helpers.drop_snapshot_differ_local_state_emissions` in the SAME change.
That suppression exists only because the caller passes the legacy `(prev, curr)` pair; migrating
the caller makes the suppressed emissions correct again, and leaving both in place would silently
drop real work.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Establish whether the absence-probe path is still wanted, or whether ADR 0028 para 2's
   direct-GET confirmation has since been implemented elsewhere and this chain is genuinely dead
   code to delete. Record the answer with a citation either way.
2. If wanted: a RED-first test proving `(inbound, probe)` is produced from the real
   production call path, not from a hand-built `local_state` fixture.
3. If dead: remove the chain, and remove the fixture-only test with it.
data.title: Inbound-probe dispatch chain has no live producer
